description: clinic unset. The letter's reply writes follow_up's marker on its own line after the first: 30
renders it as the macro's body whole, its final line ending included. Each problem paragraph is followed by
problem_close, which 30's engine joins by a blank line, its body's trailing white space trimmed. The problems
deliverable starts with clinic_line, Seen at: and the unset clinic, which 30 trims.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 58, seen for type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol on metformin; follow-up booked in three months. (Fictional.)
problems: Type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c of 71 mmol/mol (fictional)
